description: QC-013 VQE problem, not the variational search. Same ZZ law as execute_2local_hamiltonian: returns the exact energy energy_num/energy_den of the presented config, graded against the one energy QMACourtLaw holds a seal for (-1/1, constraints 0,1,1,1 with config 0,1). WIN means the presented config reaches it with no aligned term; MISS means an evaluated config that does not; a REFUSED_* verdict names an instance the law does not grade. Floats refused (REFUSED_FLOAT); a field posted as a JSON value that is not a string is REFUSED_NOT_A_STRING.

config.description: computational bits s0,s1,... each 0 or 1, one per site, comma-separated, e.g. 0,1

constraints.description: ZZ terms i,j,jnum,jden separated by ;, e.g. 0,1,1,1 (sites 0 and 1, coupling 1/1) - the same law as execute_2local_hamiltonian

name: verify_vqe_energy
